reviews.title: Flew Virgin America and then Virgin Australia back
reviews.text: They overbooked (somewhat common( so the airline put me in Business Class. It was much better. Our son also flies on this airline and I can now see why.
reviews.author: James D

reviews.title: Outreach flight to Puerto Vallarta
reviews.text: All of our flights were good. All boarded early and left on time. The cabin service was good and we were as acomfortable as you can be flying economy.
reviews.author: WR Bird

reviews.title: Totally good flight from Melbourne to Gold Coast
reviews.text: Painless check-in. Everything on time. Flight crew were excellent. Seats fine for short haul (2 hours). No problems, hassles or other put off. Our selected check in kiosk failed as it ran out of baggage tags, and the baggage drop machine failed, but we had immediate and competent personal attention. The Virgin employees were on the ball. Machines will never replace people. NOTE: This is review of Virgin Australia, NOT Virgin America (now Australian Airlines) For years I have thought Virgin the best domestic ariline in Australia. This trip did not disappoint.
reviews.author: Yankee in 0z

reviews.title: Love the AirBus with the Misting System
reviews.text: Alaska Airlines is my favorite airline. They are consistently the best with On-Time Service, Friendliness, and Professionalism. They fly the Boeing 737 and the Airbus 319 & 320. I like the 320's with the misting system. It is a nice touch when you board. The service, staff and the crews are the best. The food is standard airline food but it is above average.
reviews.author: baja-alan

reviews.title: Very average
reviews.text: The only reason I took this flight is that it is the only non-stop to San Diego for the west coast of FL .... Ft Meyers, Sarasota (where I live), Tampa and Orlando Market...which is ridiculous!! The flight was good. The service was good but to go across country and not offer decent food/sandwiches is a disgrace. I have complained before but to no avail. I will be going on a 1 stop flight, the next time I fly to San Diego. The long drive is just not worth the non-stop advantage.
reviews.author: janiss

reviews.title: Good, Steady Airline
reviews.text: First Class is just getting to be Okay Class on this airline. Seats are better (than coach), service is better, food is good, but certainly not worth the expense if you have to pay for it. (I was upgraded from a coach fare.) Flight attendants and pilots are always friendly and helpful. But like many airlines these days, flights are jammed, overhead baggage bins are jammed. And the Seattle airport was unusually crowded this October, even on a weekday.
reviews.author: Rollo P

reviews.title: A Great Flight
reviews.text: I flew from San Diego to San Francisco on Alaska Airlines and enjoyed my time on board. It was the first time that I had flown with them and believe me it will not be the last. They made me feel so welcome. It was a most enjoyable trip.
reviews.author: josieb170

reviews.title: Virgin America  Was the  BEST  !!! Alaska not  even close.....
reviews.text: BEST people- Best Planes- Best Experience -Lost so many customers and teammates after it was sold to Alaska-
reviews.author: dar2027

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Everything went well the staff are so helpful all your needs are meet to a high standard .we enjoyed ever it all
reviews.author: Cheryl W

reviews.title: Should be better
reviews.text: We expected more. The flight had many spaces throughout the plane however, we never had any of the 3 options of meals supplied on our 11.5hr flight, just what was left. Never good with children who had been presented with a menu choice when we take off. The inflight entertainment was “ok” but not up to selections on Far Eastern airlines . All in all I’m glad I had my own noise cancelling earphones, and slept the majority of the journey. Better service on the way back, apart from the hrs delay on the plane .
reviews.author: lifesworthit

reviews.title: Disney Holiday
reviews.text: As usual we were well looked after on both flights. There was 6 of us travelling 4 adults 2 children, we were all sat together. In flight entertainment was good, Food, dinner was ok and children's meal was excellent but for tea it was a high tea, sandwiches and a scone , if the sandwiches had of been just plain ham then that would of been fine but they had a cream cheese on and both children would not eat them. No complaints over flight.
reviews.author: PrestonPugface

reviews.title: The are virgin when it comes to Cabin.
reviews.text: The cabin suits the name and color and concept of the airline. They a very comfy and cozy cabin with flight entertainment better than others offering Domestic US travel
reviews.author: Ojha01

reviews.title: visit to San Francisco
reviews.text: the Whole experience was pleasant, check in no problem! Staff fantastic! Baggage claim was no problem!,
reviews.author: Pat-from-Philly

reviews.title: 6 hours in Sanfrancisco
reviews.text: Smaller aircraft, clean little service in 50 mins. Just water or juice, very tight security check in , shoes removed too etc. polite staff. Was a little nervous never heard of them but smooth flights.. Thanks.
reviews.author: Robyn V

reviews.title: Virgin airways flight to Bali
reviews.text: Paid over $1200 for the flight. Will never travel by Virgin. Real rubbish, uncomfortable seats, no screens/tv, no food, pathetic at this high price which was a code share with SIA BUT OPERATED BY VIRGIN whereas the return trip was by Singapore Airlines. Top notch classy service by Dreamliner and A380, good food,drinks, entertainment etc. I will never travel by Virgin unless the fare happens to be 1/3rd of this, otherwise happy to give Virgin a miss totally. Maybe Virgin Atlantic is good but the 7 plus hours to Bali via Brisbane was crap.
reviews.author: Sundaresan.Sarma

reviews.title: LA to Hawaii roundtrip
reviews.text: Great entertainment. Professional flight attendants. Good food. Everything ran right on schedule. Very friendly and attentive crew kept the drinks coming and plenty of munchies.
reviews.author: David S

reviews.title: Economy really means economy
reviews.text: The seats were smaller than I have seen before, and we were unfortunately stuck in the last row at the back of the plane. The seats did not recline at all and the noise from the flushing toilet was horrendous. Lucky for the people in the row in front of us who could recline there seats into our laps but we could not recline anywhere. Lucky it was only a shortish flight or the lack of tv screens really would have annoyed me.
reviews.author: Sharyne Tuari

reviews.title: Always Awesome
reviews.text: I have never been disappointed with Virgin America and now that Alaska Air is at the helm, the high-quality choice in movies is improved. I love love love Virgin America and I am such a skeptic. Love the non-stops and reasonable pricing. Love Virgin!
reviews.author: Tasha K

reviews.title: Great Flight, Great Service
reviews.text: Recently took a flight out to Los Angeles to go visit my new grandbaby and I was a bit concerned about the change from Virgin. I had flown them before for business and had a very pleasurable experience but I had never flown on Alaska Airlines before. However, I was pleasantly surprised. The flight was fantastic and the service/crew was very friendly. I also signed up for their rewards program since we plan many more trips out to the West Coast. I'm very happy to report that Alaska Airlines is a new favorite.
reviews.author: David S

reviews.title: Virgin America/ Alaska
reviews.text: Very good experience nice plane we got upgraded seats on the flight back because we got the credit card. Free drinks and food. A lot of leg room in the seats right behind first class.
reviews.author: Nesslv79

reviews.title: Missed my first flight - thanks for helping me get home
reviews.text: The staff at Dallas FW were so helpful When I missed my flight - they made sure I got another flight to catch my connection at Atlanta - Flown many times with many airlines , but Virgin has been the best Co. by far . All passengers treated with kindness My connecting flight was only 40 minutes to take off and they made sure I was rushed through to the next terminal - very grateful -
reviews.author: Janis42and77

reviews.title: Flying can really feel like flying with Virgin airline
reviews.text: Flyer can really feel like flying with Virgin Atlantic airline because it was so smooth a journey on air and they have the most exquisite furnishing plus great team of hostess... don't ask what that means. I love the treatment I got all through the journey.
reviews.author: NonemekCreativity

reviews.title: Top domestic flights
reviews.text: You always have been in top domestic flights as regards to safety, services and operations measurements Loved the luxury of seats and purple ambiance so lovely and relaxing
reviews.author: Maha Hanno

reviews.title: Very enjoyable flight
reviews.text: We had a "red eye" flight but the flight crew made it very comfortable and enjoyable for us. Would definitely fly with them again!
reviews.author: George M

reviews.title: The Virgin America Experience Diluted by Alaskan Air
reviews.text: Our observations of Virgin America as a great airline still stand. We were excited to be able to fly to/from DCA to/from Dallas' Love Field. Great flight, proximity to downtown Dallas and our favorite Warwick International Hotel and to our grand kids. But no longer - Alaskan appears to have eliminated the Dallas to DCA route. What? Thank you Alaskan - now we have to fly AA from DCA to DFW (ugh!)
reviews.author: jrjojo

reviews.title: Badly treated by agents in Loreto
reviews.text: Went down on the same airline with the same carry on but when we went to get our boarding passes at the counter in Loreto our bags were measured and we were told we had to pay and check them. Why when they were a fine size flying down are they now unacceptable? Obviously the agents in Loreto are contracted and Alaska doesn’t know how they treat the passengers in the Loreto airport. My husband got upset at this and asked if we could have seats next to each other since we were now paying to check bags. The agent said he put us in an exit row together. Most of the way through the security line I noticed my seat assignment was 33F and the ticket was for someone else besides me. We had to exit the security line and go back to the ticket counter. Then as we were leaving the airport for the airplane my husband was told his boarding pass was no good. Coincidence? I think not.
reviews.author: Sarah G

reviews.title: Beautiful planes and great service
reviews.text: Had a great flight from LAX to Puerto Vallerta. Paid a. little extra for an exit row seat with extra leg room. $30 baggage fee was annoying Plan was very clean and seats very comfortable
reviews.author: Wiscyken

reviews.title: Impressed
reviews.text: I flew to San Diego with my family to join my graduating class at Ashford University. The flight was on time and the flight instructions were a choreographed video like the movie Soul Plane. I was excited seeing that because it didn't seem real. My wife and son were flipping out because they had Mrs. PacMan. I watched TV programs as well as the overview of my flight, the path we are flying, the time of arrival with a simulation of the plane in the air. Awesome! Best flight ever in my life on a commercial liner.
reviews.author: ricardofogel

reviews.title: Great Airline
reviews.text: Great aircraft and very comfy seats. Free movies with TV’s on every seat. Check in was quick at the Alaska Terminal and flight was on time. Flight attendants were OK with their service. We have had better and friendlier service on previous flights. We always fly Alaska to Puerto Vallarta which is 4-5 times a year.
reviews.author: Christine S

reviews.title: Best flight to the west coast in years
reviews.text: I have always liked Virgin America and this is the first flight I've taken to California since they were bought by Alaska. Well, this was a wonderful flight - both down and back. Very comfortable seats, leaving on time (or early), good entertainment. I will definitely fly them again.
reviews.author: yuda101

reviews.title: Comfortable flight
reviews.text: There was no hassle, there was leg room. The attendants were attentive, the plane was clean. The flight was on time. That is just about all I need.
reviews.author: beachladybeads

reviews.title: Pleasant flight with good price
reviews.text: We booked our first flight with Alaska airlines for this trip. We flew on a Virgin plane. We had connecting flights both to Honolulu and back. Though the layovers were a bit long, the flights were on time, the boarding was orderly, and there were no issues. The flight crew was attentive. There was a pretty good selection of movies and shows to watch on the flight. I liked that we were able to monitor the flight pattern and see how far away we were from our destination. I would fly Alaska again.
reviews.author: DAL1990PegS

reviews.title: Love the Seat Back Screens
reviews.text: I flew from Seattle to San Diego on the Virgin America Airbus series plane. The flight was a delight but the attitude and service could have been better. The staff seemed distant and not very attentive. The meal and beverage service was just OK, nothing special. A bit of a disappointment as I regularly fly Alaska and have always given them high marks. One nice feature is the seat back screen with movies and a flight map showing flight info and the route and progress. Much better than the Boeing 737-900's.
reviews.author: baja-alan

reviews.title: Time to upgrade the interior
reviews.text: The service, on time factory and overall friendly interaction with the new Virgin to Alaska airlines remains the same. My only beef is with the tight economy passenger seating on the Virgin planes. I'm only 5'8" and found legroom almost nonexistent. WOW! When flying the Alaska equipment, space is a premium but not nearly this tight. At some point, travelers must demand more room. Also, what's up with these giant padded seat belts on Virgin flights? Get rid of them pronto!
reviews.author: Martin S

reviews.title: Poor attitude
reviews.text: Not sure what it is, but flight attendants on Virgin America flights have such poor attitudes compared to Alaska. Not sure if the flight crews are ex-Virgin staff or not, but they need to learn to smile and remember who the customer is.
reviews.author: David M

reviews.title: Pleasant Experience at 30,000 Feet
reviews.text: Caught a flight from San Jose CA to Portland, OR and actually expected we would be flying a typical Alaska Airline plane. I was surprised to board a Virgin plane (having forgotten that A Air had purchased Virgin. The plane was amazing actually, New, well equipped, clean and nice amenities, and plenty of leg room considering it was such a short flight. Great crew!
reviews.author: ken p

reviews.title: So much room in 1st class I couldn't touch the seat in front of me.
reviews.text: A super comfortable plane. Reclining seat with foot rest and built in TV screen. Huge leg room and generous seat width. The second leg od the trp to Zihua MX was in a 737 and f1st class felt like coach compared to the Airbus Virgin flight.
reviews.author: RandiJain B

reviews.title: Coldest flight of my life
reviews.text: On our recent return from Florida, we experienced one of our worst flights on Alaska Air. As we loaded the plane, we were told that if the carry ons wouldn't fit in the overhead and they had to check them, that checked luggage may have to be moved to a later flight, What? Our paid checked bags removed for carry ons. Than they tell us no entertainment system. One nice thing on AA is the free movies, not on this flight. Then as we expect to take off, they say they are overweight because of head winds. They had to have 5 volunteers to take flights the next day. 45 minutes later we finally took off. While sitting there we repeatedly had requested for an increase of temperature or blankets because it was extremely cold. After we took off we got a short blast of extremely high heat, then it went back to freezing. This continued for the remainder of the flight. And with no heat and no entertainment, did they offer to comp our drinks or use of WiFi? Of course not. Flight out was good, but never expected to need down parkas on a flight from FL to LA. I know it's owned by Alaska Air now, but come on guys.
reviews.author: jenzapp

reviews.title: Reliable Flight
reviews.text: My flight from Calgary connected through Seattle and on to Omaha. All flights were on schedule, was competitive cost, and reasonable departure and arrival times. Made it easy to pick up a rental car in Omaha. The longer flight offered healthy snack food trays at a small cost to supplement the free beverage service.
reviews.author: Allan H

reviews.title: Alaska Airlines Review
reviews.text: We took a red eye so we could spend the day sight seeing until our room was ready. This was a business trip but we decided we wanted to throw in some personal time also. The plane was awesome we could watch movies or sleep. The flight was 218.00 round trip but since we were going to be sleeping we decided to pay an extra $119.00 for the extra leg room. It was well worth it. You can't fly to LA for that.
reviews.author: Dissapointed1952

reviews.title: Above and Beyond
reviews.text: We had an incredible service from our flight attendant. He was very engaging and friendly. He found ways to connect on mutual interests and exceeded our expectations by far.
reviews.author: Daniel V

reviews.title: Missed flight @ LAX due to TSA. Got flt to DC thru SFO. Only delayed 90 min.
reviews.text: Really loved V.A., Alaska is trying hard to match their level of sevice. Doing good so far except for the food.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Most comfortable flight ever
reviews.text: The staff were attentive, colourful in their attire and their behaviour, always entertaining and try to make us laugh. The food was really superior quality, the choice of entertainment was completely different to that we'd experience before on British Airways. The selection was vast and nicely presented in a modern control centre where one could play games. The seats were so comfortable.
reviews.author: Ruth Rodger

reviews.title: Virgin America
reviews.text: I was very impressed with this airline - The flight crew were great -everything was very efficient. The aeroplane look like it was brand new - Food was great
reviews.author: glkl

reviews.title: Enjoyed flying Alaska from San Jose to Boston via LA
reviews.text: An early morning flight from SJC - LA - BOS. Comfortable & quick first leg, but I forgot to enter my TSA Pre # so security was not quick. Plane pulled in a bit late for my short connection, but everything worked out fine. The flight from LA - BOS was lightly booked. The plane was comfy, staff were great. Only downside: The internet service was not free, (my Jet Blue flight out had free internet.)
reviews.author: Rich S

reviews.title: No Fun Flying Anymore
reviews.text: Oh, for the good old days! I think that about every flight I take these past dew years, but this last one was really a big disappointment. On the outbound, I had a middle seat. I have not flown in one for a really long time, as I try to sit on the aisle due to my height. However, Igave up that seat to another traveler who was even taller than my 5 ft 10. Actually, there was decent space under the seat ahead for my legroom, but the 3 individuals seated ahead of me reclined their seats which resulted in very cramped space. I used the cubicle called a bathroom. I am tall, but slender, and it was not a comfortable experience either from space or sanitation. However, this seems to be the new norm, and I am not liking it to the extent I will avoid anything but first class in the future. I realize these conditions are not exclusive to Alaska Airlines, but I do think that offering one package of 2 Biscoff cookies and beverage service AFTER selling everything possible is unpleasant to put it mildly. Sad 😔
reviews.author: Bella K

reviews.title: Very comfortable and smooth ride :)
reviews.text: We were amazed at how smooth the ride was. The TV's in the back of the seat in front of you was such a nice surprise.
reviews.author: k2martin629

reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Great service, relaxed and fun. Couldn't have enjoyed the flight more. The only thing that would have been better was not having anyone else on the plane :)
reviews.author: Kelly L

reviews.title: Fly with me LA to New York, New York to Vegas
reviews.text: Very nice staff and clean plane. We had late fliht overnight to New York so no food and early to Vegas so no food but drink service very good.
reviews.author: Caroline M

reviews.title: Flight from FLL to LAX
reviews.text: This Alaska flight was still in the old Virgin America colors. The mood lighting and the excellent economy seats, combined with one of the 2 best entertainment systems in economy class in the US ( JetBlue the other). Cabin staff always superb, kind thoughtful and a good sense of humor. Check in easy,..dropped bag off and off through security. Plane left a few minutes late but arrived approx. 30 minutes ahead of schedule. The secret in the US these days is to not have to connect anywhere in the middle of the country and Alaska and JetBlue are the best in non stops..Thanks to all Alaska staff.
reviews.author: Dave J
